case.summary: Alert HHG-020 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.52 on online transaction 3509359 ($125.08) on card C12265-K2. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model evaluated the transaction at 0.006, with a historical fraud rate of only 0.6%. All 82 historical transactions on the card have occurred in billing region 264, matching the flagged transaction, and the amount aligns with the cardholder's recent spending baseline. Device D000140 is a common desktop configuration with zero confirmed fraud cases, and the card has no association with any suspicious device ring. The transaction is assessed as legitimate cardholder activity, and the case is closed with no fraud.
